{{Quote|Father, how could you do this? These are your people, our people!|Uriel Dagonet, to Senator Dagonet|<ref name="Justice" />}}
'''Uriel Dagonet'''<ref name="2024 Base">{{SWCT|set=2024 Base|cardname=Uriel Dagonet}}</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] and the son of [[Galactic Republic]] [[Senator]] [[Dagonet]] and lived on the [[planet]]<ref name="Justice" /> [[Wayyl]].<ref name="CGttSWG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> He was kidnapped<ref name="Justice" /> sometime between [[68 BBY]] and [[42 BBY]]<ref name="Date">"Justice" takes place after [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] became [[Dooku]]'s [[padawan]], but before Dooku left the [[Jedi Order]]. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of ''[[Master & Apprentice]]'' in [[40 BBY]]. Qui-Gon Jinn is forty years old in ''Master & Apprentice'', and also states he became Dooku's apprentice at twelve, which means he became an apprentice 28 years before 40 BBY, or [[68 BBY]]. Also ''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' places Dooku's departure from the Jedi Order to forty-two [[Standard year|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[42 BBY]] according to ''Star Wars: Galactic Atlas''. Therefore "Justice" takes place between these years.</ref> by lower-class citizens of the planet, who wanted to draw the attention of Senator Dagonet for his corrupt and negligent ways. He was eventually returned to his father by two [[Jedi]], [[Dooku]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn]]. This experience opened his eyes to what was happening on their planet, and made him vow to help the lower classes.<ref name="Justice" />
